title: A Good Catch Day
logline: One boat comes in low in the water with the best catch of the month; the others come in light. What happens on the sand in the next ten minutes says more than the weighing scale does.
human_question: When someone else's luck is good, what actually happens in you?

premise.story: A single morning at a small fishing harbour when catches are visibly unequal between boats.
premise.place: A beach landing site at first light, boats coming in one after another.
premise.experience: The noise and rush of unloading, then the quieter human weather that follows around who did well and who didn't.

concept_links.why: Sympathetic joy (muditā) is gladness at another's good fortune, and its failure is envy or discontent at that same fortune [C095-P4:L54].
Sympathetic joy is one of the two variable 'boundless' factors, meant to extend toward whoever is happy, not only to one's own [C024-P:L91].

what_camera_could_observe: Boats approaching with visibly uneven loads
Unloading, weighing or the morning auction
Who walks over to help or congratulate, and who keeps to their own nets
Tea, fish or conversation shared afterward, or not
what_must_be_real: The actual results of the morning's fishing, and crews' actual reactions. No directing or suggesting anyone's response.

possible_arc.opening: Boats approaching with visibly uneven catches.
possible_arc.turn: The unloading and weighing, results becoming clear to everyone.
possible_arc.ending_open: What actually happens between the crews once the scales are read.

requirements: A working fishing harbour with multiple crews returning at the same time
A morning where catches are genuinely uneven, not arranged
Crews willing to be filmed and to speak honestly

suggestions.name: A small fishing harbour on the southern coast
suggestions.why: Well-known, active fishing harbours on the south coast with daily boat landings.
suggestions.verify: No specific crews or morning have been identified or confirmed.

risks: Editing could invent rivalry or sour feeling that isn't really there
Real livelihoods are at stake in every frame; framing crews as envious without evidence would be unfair
drop_if: Crews are unwilling to be filmed on an actual uneven-catch morning

connections.note: Both centre on sympathetic joy and its opposite, shown through real, unscripted human relationships.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
